title: The Truth That Silenced the Court
intro: In a palace where denial reigned and power was absolute, a gathering of skilled practitioners stood before an unexpected challenge. The air crackled with anticipation as the two paths of falsehood and truth were about to collide. Little did the assembled ones know that this encounter would transform their lives forever and etch their story into the sacred text.
clues: We were renowned for our skill in illusions and were gathered by a powerful ruler to confront a challenger.
When the moment came, we cast our instruments and awaited the outcome, confident in our craft.
But what we witnessed made our own devices seem like mere toys, and our hearts recognized the undeniable truth.
We fell to the ground in prostration, declaring our belief in the Lord of Moses and Aaron, despite the rage of the ruler.
That ruler threatened us with the most brutal punishment, vowing to crucify us and cut our limbs opposite ways.
We remained steadfast, saying we preferred the judgment of our Lord over any worldly consequence, and we were martyred for our faith.

verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
